prompt_name: Margazhi Kolam in a Chettinad Courtyard

subject.description: An adult kolam artist drawing a precise pulli kolam with rice flour at the threshold of a Chettinad home
subject.textile: Kanchipuram silk saree with a deep maroon body, mustard-gold korvai border, and restrained temple motifs
subject.festival: Margazhi observance before sunrise, with a small brass kuthuvilakku and fresh flowers placed beside the threshold

setting.region: Kanadukathan, Chettinad, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu
setting.place: an inhabited Chettinad mansion courtyard and front thinnai
setting.period: present day, preserving an early-20th-century Chettiar domestic setting
setting.architecture: Chettinad courtyard house with lime-plastered walls, Athangudi floor tiles, Burmese-teak pillars, carved doors, and a shaded thinnai
setting.time_of_day: blue hour before sunrise on a cool Margazhi morning

lighting.description: soft blue ambient dawn light mixed with a restrained warm glow from one brass oil lamp

camera.composition: artist and kolam slightly off-centre; pillars create depth; uncluttered lived-in courtyard
camera.focus: artist's hand and emerging kolam in clear focus, architecture readable behind

style: photorealistic documentary cinema; culturally precise, quiet and lived-in rather than staged or postcard-like

motion.subject_motion: the artist pinches and releases rice flour in a continuous line, completes one loop of the pulli kolam, briefly adjusts the saree edge, then resumes drawing
motion.environment_motion: a small oil-lamp flame flickers; jasmine strands and banana leaves move very slightly in the dawn breeze
motion.camera_move: slow, stabilized 20-centimetre push-in with no orbit or sudden reframing
motion.start_frame: medium-wide view showing the artist, threshold, and half-completed kolam
motion.end_frame: slightly tighter view emphasizing the moving hand, rice-flour line, and Athangudi tiles
motion.continuity: preserve the same person, clothing, jewellery, kolam geometry, lamp position, architecture, and lighting throughout

avoid: North Indian clothing or festival props
changing face or clothing between frames
